medicare.eligibility_note: Requires Medicare Part A and Part B and residence in the plan's service area (Washington: King, Kitsap, Pierce, Snohomish, Thurston).

medicare.visitor_traveler_program: Explorer: you can stay in the plan up to 12 months while outside the service area. In the U.S. you can see an Aetna Medicare participating provider and pay in-network cost shares; out-of-network providers may cost more. You must select a PCP in the visitor area.

details: Summary of Benefits: 20%-50% coinsurance in network and 50%-70% out of network for comprehensive services (fillings, extractions, crowns and more); per-service percentages below come from the plan details page.
In-network: 20%-50% restorative; 20% endodontic; 20%-50% periodontic; 50% removable prosthodontics; 50% fixed prosthodontics; 20%-50% oral and maxillofacial surgery; 20%-50% adjunctive services
Out-of-network: 50%-70% restorative; 50% endodontic; 50%-70% periodontic; 70% removable prosthodontics; 70% fixed prosthodontics; 50%-70% oral and maxillofacial surgery; 50%-70% adjunctive services
Preventive services do not count toward the $1,000 annual allowance.
dental_comprehensive.source_text: Annual benefit amount (allowance) of $1,000 for covered comprehensive services. You are responsible for the cost of any comprehensive services over this amount.

notes: Premium is per person. For a couple, each spouse needs a plan, so double the annual premium and the out-of-pocket exposure (the app currently doubles individual amounts for a married couple).
Medical deductible in-network is $0, so every in-network service pays its copay or coinsurance from the first dollar.
Coinsurance-only items (drug tiers 3-5, DME 20%) have no dollar price on the plan page. Enter your own prices to cost them.
Out-of-network cost shares are recorded in out_of_network_services; the evaluator costs in-network use.
Part D has its own $700 deductible for tiers 3-5 and a $2,400 annual prescription out-of-pocket cap (limits.drug_deductible, limits.drug_oop_max).

assumptions: Primary source is the Aetna 2027 Summary of Benefits (form date 20260818). The plan details page (printed 10/26/26) fills items the Summary of Benefits does not list; the EOC was not provided.

Items taken only from the plan details page: annual physical, mammogram, colonoscopy, telehealth, the nursing-home specialist exception, CGM pharmacy detail, meals, star rating, and the per-service dental percentages.

The drug tier fields hold the preferred pharmacy, 30-day retail amounts. All channels (preferred and standard retail, preferred and standard mail, 30 and 100 day, and LTC) are in drugs.pharmacy_channels.
Insulin cap for 100-day channels is recorded as $105 (3 x $35), carried over from the earlier file; the Summary of Benefits states $35 per one-month supply.
General coinsurance after the deductible is not stated for this plan, so coinsurance_member_pct is null.
emergency_out_of_network_pays_in_network_rates is true because the Summary of Benefits lists the same $115 emergency copay in and out of network.
Hospital and mental health inpatient copays are per day for days 1-5 (max_units 5); days 6-90 are $0.

Dental: the cleaning is the preventive benefit ($0). The Summary of Benefits gives only ranges for comprehensive care (20%-50% in network, 50%-70% out of network), so the root canal uses the 20% endodontic share and the crown uses 50% (top of the restorative range / fixed prosthodontics) from the plan details page. The $1,000 annual allowance is per person; preventive services do not count toward it.
notes: Ambulatory surgery center price is in outpatient_surgery_facility; outpatient hospital and observation prices are in its limits. Surgeon and hospital professional fees are 'unknown' because they are not listed.
Skilled nursing: $0 days 1-20, then a daily copay for days 21-100.
Star rating is 4 of 5 stars (plan details page).
Part B standard premium for 2027 is not in the documents, so part_b_monthly is null.
Summary of Benefits non-member line: 1-844-509-6254 (TTY 711); Oct 1-Mar 31 8 AM-8 PM 7 days, Apr 1-Sep 30 8 AM-8 PM Mon-Fri. enrollment.agent_phone is the earlier agent line from the plan page.
